article.headline: Jahni Summers scores 17 as South Dakota beats Mount Marty 95-57
article.description: — South Dakota opened its season Monday with a 95-57 victory over Mount Marty, led by Jahni Summers’ 17 points.
article.linkText: Jahni Summers scores 17 as South Dakota beats Mount Marty 95-57

categories.description: Mount Marty Lancers @ South Dakota Coyotes

event.description: Mount Marty Lancers @ South Dakota Coyotes

keywords: Mount Marty Lancers @ South Dakota Coyotes
article.story: VERMILLION, S.D. -- — South Dakota opened its season Monday with a 95-57 victory over Mount Marty, led by Jahni Summers’ 17 points. Summers shot 5 for 8 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 5 from the line for the Coyotes. Vince Buzelis scored 14 points while shooting 4 for 5 from the field and 6 for 8 from the line, and added seven rebounds and six assists. Kajus Kublickas shot 4 for 6 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the line to finish with 14 points. Mande Wanlemvo led the Lancers with 17 points. Sawyer Schultz added nine points for Mount Marty. Jackson Edman also had eight points. Up next South Dakota plays Northern Kentucky at home Wednesday, and Mount Marty visits Omaha on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
